_comment: Type-checks the test suite AND the demos (frontend-guardrails §4.2: 'demos are first-class code, compiled'). noEmit; the build tsconfig emits src only. Generated stories are excluded (they are drift-gated, not hand-edited). Unlike the sibling pairs, this one type-checks demos and tests TOGETHER, so the demo suite itself is checked — which needs the `import.meta.glob` declaration in test/vite-env.d.ts.
